name: create-dev-loop
description: Generates a tailored autonomous development loop (triage, implement, PR, review, merge, self-audit) for any git repository.

name: forward-one-dev-loop
description: An autonomous dev loop generated by create-dev-loop for the Forward One game; a worked example of its output.

name: nielsen-krug-pass
description: Runs a usability pass on a UI app against Nielsen's 10 heuristics and Krug's Don't Make Me Think.

name: claude-attribution-audit
description: Finds GitHub posts made under your own account that Claude drafted but that lack an attribution sign-off, and revises them with confirmation.

name: gardener-attribution-audit
description: Brings GitHub content that the gardener automation already posted in line with its passive-voice and attribution rules.

name: create-minecraft-server
description: Stands up a Minecraft server end to end on Hetzner with OMCSI: config and ops repos, Terraform, plugins, whitelist and a live check.

name: verify-plugin-persistence
description: Proves a Dans-Plugins Minecraft plugin really persists its data across writes, restarts and backend migrations on a live Dockerized test server.

name: zettelkasten-expand
description: Grows the Dans Plugins Community zettelkasten with new concept notes, each grounded in a source pinned at a commit.

name: zettelkasten-verify
description: Audits the zettelkasten's notes against their cited sources and re-pins or corrects any that have drifted.
